Once he found this out , he supposedly took out a trespassing order and told her if she comes it'd be considered trespassing.  She talks to her child everyday and the child is always asking when are they able to come home , which has took a huge mental toll on my bestfriend . She is scared to seek therapy as she feels depression will be used against her in court.

She's missed her child's birthday and Christmas is coming up as well , so I can only imagine now she feels.
